summary: Father (31) and his young daughter lost near the Red Canyon overlook area, Colorado National Monument; reported missing after calling a family member; NPS rangers, MCSO deputies, MCSAR ground team and CareFlight searched; found safe around 3 a.m. April 15, both uninjured.
location: Red Canyon overlook area, Colorado National Monument
responding_agency: Mesa County SO; Mesa County SAR Ground Team; NPS Rangers; CareFlight
notes: Mission request ~7:30 PM April 14 per the CO SAR after-action report (cofiretech.gov); KOOL 1079 places the lost-hiker report on April 15; date = mission request date; run 78 (Mesa CrimeWatch re-check). Corroborated by DFPC CoE TAK field report CoE-19-002.1 (April 2019 TAK support deployment documentation).
